travel.title: Travel & trips
travel.metaDescription: Umrah, Hajj and holiday packages from licensed travel agencies. Request to book — no payment on Nawy.
travel.tagline: Packages from licensed travel agencies · request to book, no payment on Nawy · pay the agency directly
travel.empty: No trips match your search yet.
travel.emptyBody: Try another destination, trip type or month.
travel.comingSoon: Travel agencies are adding their packages. Check back soon.

detail.refundTier: {percent}% refund when cancelled {days}+ days before departure
detail.noPaymentPolicy: No payment on Nawy: you send a booking request, the agency confirms your seats and you pay them directly.
detail.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
detail.totalFor: Total for {count, plural, one {# traveller} other {# travellers}}
detail.noDepartures: No upcoming departures — ask the agency for dates.

inquiry.title: Ask the agency
inquiry.sent: Your question was sent to {agency}. They reply by email or phone.

book.title: Request to book
book.subtitle: One short form — no payment on Nawy. {agency} confirms availability and you pay them directly.
book.guestHint: No account needed. We email your booking reference and a link to check its status. Sign in to see it under My bookings.
book.travellerNamesHint: Add names now or share them with the agency later. No passport details or uploads are collected on Nawy.
book.notesPlaceholder: e.g. twin beds please, vegetarian meals, early check-in…
book.agree: I understand {agency} confirms my booking and I pay them directly. Nawy takes no payment.
book.mustAgree: Please confirm you understand how payment works.
book.terms: By sending you agree to the Nawy terms. Your details are shared only with this agency.
book.payAgencyTitle: Pay the agency directly — no payment on Nawy
book.payAgencyBody: {agency} confirms the final price and tells you how to pay them (bank transfer, card at their office or their own payment link).
book.pricesNote: Prices are the agency's published estimate. Your booking reference is issued when you send the request.
book.checkFieldsHint: Fix the highlighted fields and send again.
book.noSeats: Not enough seats left on this departure.
book.unavailable: This trip is not open for booking right now.

sent.title: Booking request sent
sent.body: {agency} has your request {number}. Agencies usually reply within 24 hours by email or phone.
sent.emailNote: We sent the reference and a status link to {email}.
sent.step1: The agency checks the seats and confirms the final price.
sent.step2: They contact you to arrange payment directly — nothing is charged on Nawy.
sent.step3: The status updates here and you get an email at each step.

status.title: Booking {number}

headline.held: Held — send your request before the hold ends
headline.hold_expired: Hold expired — the seats went back on sale

status.name: Name
status.cancelHint: Free to cancel while the request is pending — no charge, the held seats are released. After the agency confirms, cancelling also tells them.
status.changeSent: Your change request was sent to the agency.
status.notFoundBody: Open the link from your confirmation email on this device, or enter your booking number and access code. Booked while signed in? Sign in to see it.

my.title: My bookings
my.subtitle: Trip booking requests and their status. Payment is arranged directly with each agency.
my.empty: You have no trip bookings yet.
my.guestOnDevice: Booked as a guest on this device

resend.title: Lost your booking link?
resend.body: Enter the email you booked with and we will send you the links to your bookings again.
resend.sent: If we have bookings for {email}, the links are on their way. Check your inbox.
